coordinator_assigned_stage.ownership: agent_owned; coordinator direction, not requester definition

test_scope_terms.ownership: agent_owned test scope from coordinator; not requester terms

independent_meaning.one-eye-covering bangs: A connected opaque fringe descends from the scalp across one eye, hiding that eye while the other stays readable.
independent_meaning.ahoge: A small separate curved strand rises above the crown, distinct from the main fringe and from a general windblown silhouette.
independent_meaning.hand-covering gauntlets: A fitted forearm guard crosses the wrist and extends across the back of the hand to the knuckle roots, with distinct exposed fingers.
independent_meaning.open mesh textile: A fabric made from intersecting strands with repeated visibly empty openings through which skin or the scene can be seen.

alternatives_considered: a distant silhouette on an external catwalk
a close work-bay portrait with the filter and garment details visible
chosen_direction_reason: The heated work-bay portrait keeps all hair and hand details observable while the chart recorder, dome equipment and snowy doorway retain the mountain-facility relationship. The external silhouette would make the selected test observations too small.
reference_scope: Visible facial appearance only. Fictional adult subject and authored hair, clothing, body, staging, and biography-free scene.

theme.who: A fictional adult presence concentrated on a newly written trace, with a tactile face and authored asymmetric hair.
theme.where: A warm equipment bay inside a mountain observatory, opening toward cold snowy ridges.
theme.how: Close eye-level observation, mid-thigh crop; the subject attends to the equipment instead of performing the test features for the camera.
theme.why_now: The chart has just recorded the tracking adjustment, so fingertips and attention are still at the paper.

ownership_note: Event identity is chosen within requester-delegated random-concept scope and frozen for this run; exact test features and staging remain agent choices on open dimensions, not requester definitions.
